howto: Pick a level: Climb starts with 3-letter words and grows, or choose 3, 5 or 6 letters.
One letter is missing from each word. Tap the letter that fills the gap.
Score as many words as you can in 60 seconds. Endless mode has no clock but only 3 hearts.
tips: Say the word out loud: the missing sound often jumps out.
Wait 3 seconds and a picture clue appears above the word.
Answer within 2 seconds for a +5 slipstream bonus.
Every 4 right in a row raises your score multiplier.
A wrong answer costs 2 seconds, so a quick guess is not always best.

controls.keyboard: Type the letter or press 1-4 to pick an answer. Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap one of the four letters

difficulty: Level bands: 3-letter words (ages 5-6), 5-letter words (ages 6-7) and 6-letter words (ages 7-8), or Climb, which moves up a band every 6 right answers.

features.age-or-level-bands: Level row on the title: Climb, 3 letters, 5 letters and 6 letters, each with an age guide
features.hints: A picture clue appears after 3 seconds; the arcade Hint says whether the missing letter is a vowel and rules out one wrong answer
features.grown-up-progress-report: Grown-ups button on the title: words tried and accuracy per level, practice days, the words missed most and a suggested next level
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first game (the clock waits); replay with Learn to play
features.results: Time's Up card with score, best, combo, answer speed, medals and all-time accuracy
